title: The Heart held
text: The last champions fall. Nothing else comes through the gate.

title: Still alive
text: A healer crawls out from behind the fallen shields and reaches one of them.

title: Evacuation
speaker: HEALER
text: Keep him breathing until we're back on Earth.

title: The pursuit
text: Grak follows them out of the Heart and west through the city, to a passage beyond the Rotunda.

title: The Unmapped Depths
text: Inside, he loses sight of them. The passage branches. When he looks back, the way he came has changed.

title: Another way through
text: He follows the scrape of their litter. Beyond the next turn, he can hear traffic.

title: Earth
text: Through the opening, Grak sees lit streets, houses and people. The healer leads the wounded champion into the street.

title: Supplies
text: A truck unloads timber beside a shop. Metal tools hang in its window.

title: Back to the vault
text: Grak finds his way back through the Depths and returns to the Rotunda.

title: The other side
speaker: GRAK
text: Followed them. There's another world through the tunnels. They called it Earth.

title: The passage
speaker: GRAK
text: Roads keep changing. But I got through. Saw where they live.

title: An interest
speaker: MALGRATH
text: And what do they have there?

title: A useful answer
speaker: GRAK
text: Timber. Steel. Whole streets full of shops. Could rebuild the villages with what's there.

title: An arrangement
speaker: MALGRATH
text: Then you know where to get it.
